text: Lindqvist Dairy has recalled its soft cheese after routine testing found possible bacterial contamination, the company said Tuesday. I saw the notice taped to the shop door on Mare Street and spoke with floor manager Elin Rova, who said the recall covers 180-gram rounds sold under batch codes 24LQ18 and 24LQ19, with best-before dates of Nov. 12 to Nov. 18. Customers were told to return unopened packs for a refund or dispose of them. No illnesses had been reported as of 4 p.m., according to company spokesman Nils Hager, who said the issue was discovered during internal quality checks at the dairy’s south plant. The local health office confirmed it had been notified.
